parts.name: Cherry Studio Desktop App
parts.description: Electron desktop application containing main, preload, renderer, data layer, API server, knowledge, MCP, and agent systems.

parts.name: @cherrystudio/ui
parts.description: Internal UI design system package built on Tailwind CSS v4 and React.

parts.name: @cherrystudio/ai-core
parts.description: Unified AI provider abstraction and plugin-enabled execution layer.

parts.name: @cherrystudio/ai-sdk-provider
parts.description: CherryIN-oriented provider adapter for the Vercel AI SDK ecosystem.

parts.name: @cherrystudio/provider-registry
parts.description: Static provider and model registry data plus loader utilities.

parts.name: mcp-trace
parts.description: Tracing utilities shared across node and web environments.

parts.name: @cherrystudio/extension-table-plus
parts.description: TipTap table extension fork used by the editor stack.

parts.name: @vectorstores/libsql
parts.description: libSQL-backed vector store implementation used by knowledge features.

integration_points.details: Renderer imports shared UI components, icons, styles, and hooks from the internal UI package.
Renderer-side AI workflows use ai-core abstractions to talk to model providers.
ai-core relies on custom provider bundles for specific upstream compatibility behavior.
App loads static provider/model registry data as packaged runtime resources.
Main and renderer both depend on trace-core and environment-specific tracing helpers.
Rich text editing flows use the internal TipTap table extension.
Knowledge workflows use the libSQL vector store implementation.
